dedupe_keys.name: fermium hazard mapper input data and outputs for flood and landslide susceptibility in bangladesh version 2

description: The Fermium Hazard Mapper version 2 deposit provides four regional input-and-output archives for Bangladesh: Rangpur–Rajshahi, Sylhet, the south-west coast and the Chittagong Hill Tracts. Zenodo lists one small JSON manifest per archive with file sizes, SHA-256 checksums and file-specific rights. The manifests were read; all four list geoBoundaries, not GADM files. The provider reports flood masks from thirteen Sentinel-1 events in 2017–2024, asset scores, probability and risk grids, administrative summaries and validation metrics; the Hill Tracts archive addresses rainfall-triggered landslide susceptibility. These files can test exposure and hazard-model outputs in infrastructure resilience simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this corrected release. A limitation is that version 1 used unredistributable GADM boundaries and a coordinate error that reportedly made training labels zero; users must identify the version before reuse. Zenodo claims CC BY 4.0 for outputs, while raw inputs retain manifest-specific rights. The linked code README says MIT but GitHub metadata does not classify its licence. No large archive was downloaded and no prediction was reproduced.
